title: Advanced topics should be shown at root level
body:
Instead of being "hidden" under a click on "advanced topics", we should show them in the main navigation.

Because those "advanced" topic are actually pretty recurrent questions so it's only "Advanced" because of the way we implement them, not in term of actual usage.

Example from the [vuejs website](http://vuejs.org/) (:pray:)
